extraction.Name: Mary Ione Valandry Reynolds
extraction.Refused/Protested: did not know that she was to receive a patent and it came to her at Vetal, S.D. in a letter from the Superintendent of the Pine Ridge Reservation, on Jan. 1920
extraction.Recorded patent: she never had the patent recorded
extraction.Sold/Mortgaged: had to mortgage the land to get money on the land
extraction.Buyer: Claud Dale of Norris, S.D. holds the mortgage and is being foreclosed at present
extraction.Tax burden forced sale/Mortgage: she was unable to pay the taxes on the land and had to mortgage the land to get money on the land
extraction.Occupation/Income: all of her support comes from the land; she is living on the land and has farmed about 80 acres
extraction.NOTES: mentally competent; first mortgaged the land for $500.00, had the mortgage renewed and now there is close to $2200.00 against the land with taxes and mortgage; has not received any aid from the Government, State, or County since the patent was granted; document subscribed and sworn before notary public on the 20th day of [month unclear], 1929; patent received at Vetal, S.D. | ORIGINAL_TRIBE_VALUE: "Pine Ridge Reservation" (normalized 2026-04-28 to canonical 'Pine Ridge')

recovery_notes.rationale: Pine Ridge tribe field had 40+ string variants across the corpus. Consolidating to canonical 'Pine Ridge' for clean tabulation while preserving original variant in NOTES for audit.
